#   ConfigServer Threat Database › Telnet › 1 Day
#   Telnet Protocol
#   
#   These blocklists are maintained directly by ConfigServer and are
#   compiled from connection attempts against our Telnet honeypots,
#   as well as unauthorized access attempts targeting legacy Telnet
#   services we operate.
#   
#   The threat feeds capture malicious Telnet activity across exposed
#   internet-facing infrastructure, including automated scanners and
#   brute force tools commonly used against unsecured remote access
#   services.
#   
#   IP addresses included in this dataset have been observed attempting
#   actions such as credential brute forcing, unauthorized login
#   attempts, vulnerability scanning, and automated probing of Telnet
#   endpoints.
#   
#   Blocklists prefixed with `_1d` represent activity observed within
#   the most recent 24-hour period and reflect confirmed Telnet
#   connection attempts during that window, treated as high-confidence
#   indicators of malicious behavior.
#   
#   Blocklists prefixed with `_365d` are cumulative datasets covering
#   a one-year period and may include a higher rate of false positives
#   due to IP reuse, NAT, and infrastructure changes across providers.
